verdict.rationale: Edge0 serves an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint, so a downloadable machine-readable spec is a fair question for it. However, the evidence never mentions an OpenAPI or equivalent spec the product publishes or exposes. Being compatible with another vendor's API is an adjacent fact and does not count as the product shipping its own spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
